custom-fields.heading: Custom fields
custom-fields.heading-copy: Define the details your firm collects before advisors start filling them in.
custom-fields.catalog-copy: A field’s name can change later. Its saved values keep the same field id.
custom-fields.retired: Retired fields stay with existing records but are not offered for new details.
custom-fields.empty: No custom fields yet. Add one when the standard details are not enough.
custom-fields.save-failed: Could not save the custom field catalog.
custom-fields.load-failed: Could not load the custom field catalog.
